claim: The ledger names a design document MILLI.DOC, but it is absent from the vendored tree and embedded nowhere — a secondary-doc gap, not a ground-truth gap.
The ledger names a picture source 368XX.SB2, also absent — the picture pixels come from the MAME 136013-106/107 set, not from this tree.
Scoring ground truth is the code, not the missing doc: PTS is a 16-entry table (.BLKB 16., decimal by the trailing period) of per-critter points.

source.verbatim: PTS:	.BLKB 16.		;NUMBER OF POINTS FOR KILLING THIS CRITTER

claim: Difficulty is an operator option-switch (DIP) setting documented in the source: D1=BEETLE DIFFICULTY.
The difficulty option bits run through D6=SPIDER DIFFICULTY — the per-bit difficulty MLDEF documents in place of the missing MILLI.DOC.
